source_style: Real pre-post intervention study with naturalistic dropout

columns.name: Subject
columns.notes: Participant ID, format PT-XXX (PT-001 to PT-025). TEXT not integer.

columns.name: Time
columns.notes: Measurement timepoint: 'Pre' or 'Post'. Categorical condition variable.

columns.name: AnxietyScore
columns.notes: GAD-7 anxiety scale score (range 0-63; higher = greater anxiety severity)

sheets.name: Notes
sheets.purpose: Study metadata, data quality notes, and analysis guidance

clean_table.structure: Each row = one subject × one timepoint. Subject PT-001 appears in rows 2-3 (Pre, Post), PT-002 in rows 4-5, etc.

intended_analysis.primary: Paired t-test (Pre vs Post anxiety scores)
intended_analysis.secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank test (non-parametric alternative if scores non-normal)
intended_analysis.repeated_measures: One-way repeated measures ANOVA (Pre vs Post, accounting for subject nesting)
intended_analysis.intent: Evaluate efficacy of cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) intervention in reducing anxiety

mess_applied.structure_quirk: Empty first sheet followed by data on second sheet (mimics real-world workbook organization)
mess_applied.incompleteness: 3 subjects (PT-008, PT-015, PT-022) missing Post measurements (post-intervention attrition/no-show)
mess_applied.column_order: LONG format requires awareness of grouping structure; naive reader might treat rows independently
mess_applied.categorical_encoding: Time is text ('Pre'/'Post') not numeric (1/2) or ordinal

what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.mistake_1: Treating rows as independent observations rather than nested within subjects (loses pairing information)
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.mistake_2: Attempting t-test on all 47 rows (n=47) instead of recognizing 25 subjects with 22 valid pairs
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.mistake_3: Including rows from subjects with only Pre (or only Post) as separate groups instead of removing them for paired analysis
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.mistake_4: Computing summary statistics per row rather than per subject per timepoint
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.mistake_5: Not noticing the empty first sheet and attempting to read from the wrong range/sheet
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong.correct_approach: Pivot or group by Subject; identify complete pairs (n=22); compute Pre-Post difference per subject; test mean difference

realistic_context.study_design: Randomized controlled trial of cognitive behavioral therapy for generalized anxiety disorder
realistic_context.measure: GAD-7 (Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7) self-report screening scale
realistic_context.sample_size: N=25 enrolled; N=22 completed both assessments (3 post-intervention dropouts)
realistic_context.data_quality: All scores double-checked by research assistant; no missing data within completed assessments
